title: gentiana lingulata var. praecox
intro: Gentiana lingulata var. praecox, commonly known as Chinese gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family, native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting effects. The therapeutic actions of Chinese gentian include its ability to improve digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Chinese gentian include iridoids, gentiopicroside, and gentiacauleine, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
